title: Tested quality
description: How a service does on EuKollab's own tests: buyers' trial cases rerun by the network as ordinary calls. Counts are always given; the rating only once the evidence is significant (at least 50 counted runs on 20 cases in 8 groups of similar inputs, written by 3 independent organisations, over 14 days). t is the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the pass rate times the accuracy, over the last 90 days on the current major version.

significant.description: Whether the evidence is enough to show the rating.

clusters.description: Groups of similar inputs among them.

organisations.description: Independent organisations whose cases they are.

pass_rate.description: Runs at or above their case's threshold ÷ runs; null until significant.

accuracy.description: The mean score of the runs; null until significant.

consistency.description: 1 − the mean difference between a case's consecutive scores; null until significant or with no repeated case.

t.description: The tested-quality value; null until significant.

band.description: Excellent from 0.90, Good from 0.75, Fair from 0.50, else Poor; null until significant.

major.description: The major version of the service these numbers are for.
